title: improve(ui): keep native selects in the shared select family

commit.messageHeadline: improve(ui): keep native selects in the shared select family
fix(ui): keep long select values inside the shared select
fix(ui): truncate long select values with an ellipsis
fix(ui): center the select chevron in Safari
fix(ui): cap the select popup and truncate long options
fix(ui): note the settings select label assertion
fix(ui): match the Systems phone selects to the icon buttons beside them
test(ui): cover select class composition in retained-control case

Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes The PR preserves shared select classes and replaces competing page-specific styling with the existing select family. **Example:** Sessions displays the “25 per page” selector. - **Before:** The caller’s class replaces settings-select, leaving a small browser-default control. - **After:** Both classes remain, giving the selector shared field styling at its intended 30px height. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** | A focused owner-level repair with directly inspected visual evidence, useful regression coverage, and no actionable findings. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** ✨ media proof bonus | Sufficient (screenshot): Inspected browser screenshots exercise the actual Sessions and Systems controls with synthetic Gateway data, showing shared chrome after the fix in light, dark, mobile CRT, and Safari presentations; they establish visible styling, not open-popup interaction. | | **Patch quality** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Several native selects lose shared styling or use inconsistent corners and arrows. **Reason:** The source-backed class defect violates the established shared-control contract, and the maintainer-authored styling changes continue the existing design direction. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** Keep open: this maintainer-authored PR repairs a verified shared-select styling defect that remains on main; no actionable regression was found. **Priority:** P3 **Reviewed head:** `91ca3451e2f014c747b27cdd70d81517cfe9ff5c` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Control UI pages supply options, selected values, and handlers to native selects; shared components and CSS render the controls while existing page owners handle selection changes. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Page options and selection] --> B[SettingsSelect] B --> D[Native select] C[Specialized page selects] --> D E[Shared field and select styles] --> D D --> F[Existing page change handlers] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Retain the shared class at the renderer and let existing select styles own chrome while callers retain only necessary geometry. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main source shows the class overwrite and four affected callers; supplied before/after screenshots corroborate its visible effect without executing target code during this review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The patch fixes the producer, reuses existing styling owners, removes competing declarations, and adds one distinct class-preservation regression without unnecessary machinery. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [e97c9d3d7417](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e97c9d3d74178e0d96f654f1b6f5ea5bafb581f9). ### Provenance checked - `Shared native select renderer` keeps the original intent (325c87d4688898e63343e0867c1b468206549d52: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182796 consolidated repeated option rendering while promising to preserve caller classes and behavior.) - `Select popup and chevron family` keeps the original intent (07fae10c385a11513085ed8c37aa5c890af5b9a6: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188283 gave native and custom selects shared styling with browser-appropriate fallbacks.) - `Field tokens and page-specific chrome` keeps the original intent (880bdcd2fdd4e5f49c2ad9b4a392e1a1ba388c30: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/189632 standardized field appearance; older page designs supplied local geometry that this PR preserves where needed.) ### Testing Proof path: shipped entry point. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Current-main defect:** Fetched main still spreads caller attributes after class="settings-select", allowing caller classes to replace the shared class. ([`ui/src/components/solid/settings-select.tsx:12`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e97c9d3d74178e0d96f654f1b6f5ea5bafb581f9/ui/src/components/solid/settings-select.tsx#L12), [e97c9d3d7417](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e97c9d3d74178e0d96f654f1b6f5ea5bafb581f9)) - **Focused owner-level repair:** The introduced diff excludes class from the spread, composes both classes, adopts the shared family in specialized controls, and removes their competing chrome without changing selection handlers. ([`ui/src/components/solid/settings-select.tsx:10`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/91ca3451e2f014c747b27cdd70d81517cfe9ff5c/ui/src/components/solid/settings-select.tsx#L10), [91ca3451e2f0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/91ca3451e2f014c747b27cdd70d81517cfe9ff5c)) - **Inspected visual evidence:** Inspected the four prepared Sessions screenshots and the additional linked mobile CRT before/after and Safari images. They show the corrected pager, grouping controls, machine picker, theme corners, and desktop sizing chrome in the running UI with synthetic data. ([91ca3451e2f0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/91ca3451e2f014c747b27cdd70d81517cfe9ff5c)) - **Original renderer contract:** The original addition and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182796 establish that the shared renderer should preserve native controls, caller classes, attributes, and handlers; the repair restores that intent. ([`ui/src/components/solid/settings-select.tsx:12`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/325c87d4688898e63343e0867c1b468206549d52/ui/src/components/solid/settings-select.tsx#L12), [325c87d46888](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/325c87d4688898e63343e0867c1b468206549d52)) - **Established visual direction:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188283 established the select family, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/189632 established shared field tokens; this PR continues both designs while retaining dense-control heights.
